from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyEquityData(BaseModel):
    """Financial equity data extracted from one company's filing for a specific period."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name as reported in the filing")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period date in YYYY-MM format")
    retained_earnings: float | None = Field(description="Retained Earnings amount as reported; use negative value if it's an accumulated deficit")
    retained_earnings_unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit scale of the retained earnings figure: 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions'")
    accumulated_other_comprehensive_income_loss: float | None = Field(description="AOCI amount as reported; must be signed (negative for loss, positive for income)")
    accumulated_other_comprehensive_income_loss_unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit scale of the AOCI figure: 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions'")
    retained_earnings_quote: str | None = Field(description="Brief verbatim or paraphrased anchor for retained earnings line")
    aoci_quote: str | None = Field(description="Brief verbatim or paraphrased anchor for AOCI line")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_equity_data: list[CompanyEquityData]
